title: Heitor Returns to the Game, Confronts Pilar in 'Quem Ama Cuida'
seoTitle: Heitor Returns to the Game, Confronts Pilar
subtitle: Father's Tomb Promise Triggers New Inheritance Dispute
excerpt: After visiting Arthur's tomb, Heitor vows to uncover his father's killer and returns to the mansion to reclaim the deceased's suite, sparking tension.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Last week, the plot of Quem Ama Cuida gained new momentum when Heitor Brandão visited his father Arthur's tomb and vowed to uncover the killer. The promise materialized in Saturday's (17) episode, as the heir reappeared at Pilar's luxury penthouse, reclaiming the suite that once belonged to the patriarch.

Promise at the Tomb and Return to the Land of the Living

Heitor (Renato Góes) fulfills the promise made to his father, declaring upon arrival at the cemetery that he will unravel the crime that took Arthur's life. His return to family life is mediated by Adriana (Letícia Colin), who introduces Heitor to a meeting about the Brandão Joias audit, revealing that the true heir is alive.

Direct Conflict with Pilar

Pilar (Isabel Teixeira) reacts furiously upon discovering Heitor intends to occupy the suite that was hers. The villainess even faints, and the dispute over the space turns into a true showdown, with Heitor asserting that he will stay in his father's house. Tension escalates when Pilar tries to expel everyone from her residence.

Repercussions of the Criminal Review

As the family clash intensifies, the criminal review progresses. Pedro secures unanimous support from the judges, and Adriana is acquitted, leading to celebration among allies and anger among those who still suspect her. Adriana's acquittal fuels the climate of suspicion surrounding Pilar and other family members.

New Revelations About the Jewelry Store

Ulisses confesses to Lyris that he was the one who embezzled money from the jewelry store, while Edvaldo reports to Heitor notes made after the boss's death. The audit reveals fraud in Ingrid and Ulisses' management, increasing pressure on those involved and reinforcing the need to discover who is responsible for Arthur's murder.

Developments in Alliances and Betrayals

Adriana, upon learning Heitor is alive, confronts him rudely but also tells Pedro about the situation. Iuri reveals to Pedro and Adriana that Pilar and Tom are having an affair, while Mau Mau and Felipe kiss, demonstrating that personal relationships continue to intertwine with the central drama. The plot continues to reveal who will be the next target of investigations and how the Brandão family will deal with the new revelations.

With information from Gshow, Notícias da TV, VEJA.
